result:
Round 31 passes. I found no new bugs, and the real-app checks ran, so realVerified is true. The only thing not checked is Windows packaging, which is BLOCKED because Windows packaging is not available in the cloud and isn't part of this round.

- **R31-1, scope and process:** Only the 8 owned files changed, and the one untracked file is the new `folder-read-overlap.test.ts`. The source changes are exactly what the task specifies for D-38, and `beginFolderLoad` comes after `if (!path) return;`. The store test file only gains lines. There are no comments, no `any`/`@ts-ignore` and no new `as` in `src/`. A's transcript shows no Bash writes to repository files. I re-checked at the end of my phase and the working tree had not changed.
- **R31-2, failing tests before the fix:** I put the baseline source together with A's tests in a separate copy and got 241 passed / 16 failed, with (o8) passing as intended. Every failure is the actual symptom: the wrong folder's metadata or files, the spinner flag cleared too early, or a stale toast. (o16) and (f1) fail because the new function doesn't exist yet. On A's tree all 257 tests pass in 14 files, and each of the 17 new tests passes when run alone.
- **R31-3, mutation testing:** All 19 deliberate code breakages (GM-1…GM-19) are caught, each by the tests the task expected.
- **R31-4, full gate:** It exits 0 from a clean state. Biome reports 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 30. Type checks are clean. Unit tests pass (257 renderer, 93/93 main) and the E2E suite passes 7/7, including with retries turned off.
- **R31-5, real app, old build vs new build:** I launched both builds and drove the UI. A test hook made the first folder's file read or folder scan take 5 seconds; its log confirms the slow result arrived inside the 7-second watch window.
  - **Old build:** every expected bug appeared.
    - Scenario L: `f.wav` lost its `Tagged` badge and its Category went blank.
    - Scenario J: same, plus a stale `Failed to read 1 files` message.
    - Scenario S: `s.wav` was listed while the folder label said `fast`.
    - Scenario C: the spinner stayed after Close until the slow read finished.
  - **New build:**
    - `f.wav` keeps `Tagged` and Category `R31Fast`, with no error toast.
    - Only `f.wav` is listed.
    - After Close, the "Open a folder…" prompt appears within 53 ms.
  - **All 8 runs:** the WAV files' checksums never changed after setup. Both `music-metadata` and `ffprobe` read back `R31Slow`/`R31Fast`, and there were no page errors.
  - **Not tested in the real app:** dropping a folder can't be done with Playwright, and Rescan followed by Open Folder was not driven. Unit tests (o6) and (o10)–(o15) cover both.
- **R31-6, docs:** I checked every `file:line` reference to the three changed source files against A's tree, and all point at the right code. The other edits in the old text are only line-number shifts. Entry 14, the D-38 bullet, the header, the (k7) addition, the README row and the single `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md` line all match the task.

Two items are listed for B as unconfirmed signals, not bugs:
- **A-R31-01:** a schema re-read that finishes after a folder switch might overwrite the new folder's metadata. It is untested, and I did not check it.
- **Close Folder gap:** Close Folder during a pending scan or drop has no unit test of its own. Test (o5) still catches both Close Folder breakages.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop:
- c-round-31.md
- c-round-31.json
- c-round-31/ (logs, mutation log, harness, driver script, screenshots)
